translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
1 The deniers of truth from among the People of the Book and the polytheists would not desist from disbelief until they received clear evidence—
2 a messenger from God, reciting to them pure scriptures,
4 Those who were given the Book did not become divided except after clear evidence was given to them.
5 They were commanded only to worship God, offering Him sincere devotion, to be sincere in their faith, to pray regularly and to give alms, for that is the right religion.
6 Those of the deniers of truth among the People of the Book and the polytheists will dwell forever in Hell-fire. They are the worst of creatures.
7 Truly, those who believe and do good works are the best of creatures.

8 God has a reward in store for them: Gardens of eternity, through which rivers flow they will dwell therein forever. God is well pleased with them and they are well pleased with Him. Thus shall the God-fearing be rewarded.
